# atlassian_jira_project_role (Data Source)

Look up a Jira project role and its actors (users and groups).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) Project key or ID.
- `role_id` (String) Project role ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Role description.
- `group_ids` (List of String) Group IDs in this role.
- `group_names` (List of String) Group names in this role.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `user_account_ids` (List of String) Account IDs of users in this role.
